declaration.ccd_declaration: per-substep static detection; end-of-substep overlap resolved by the next substep narrow phase; tunneling needs > 4.9 m/s (declared speed bound 4.0 m/s, T7)
declaration.momentum_ledger: per body per substep over stages 1-3: m*(v-v0) == gravity + damping + element_actuator + contact (telescoping recorded deltas), <= 1e-12; the projection impulse is internal and pairwise (its work stays in R)
declaration.residual_form: R = E_mech(t) - E_mech(t-1) - (W_act + W_lig + W_cap + W_grav) + Q_damp + Q_contact + Q_proj + E_diss_release; |R| <= reservoirs + 5e-2*turnover + 1e-9; release tick: |R| <= max(5e-2*E_diss_release, 1e-12)
declaration.upstream: M01 validator; M03 Membrane; M05 sealed bond/release interface (subclassed); M06 local contact (verbatim)
